def comb_sort(arr):
    """Sort a list using the Comb Sort algorithm."""
    
    # Gap sequence: shrink by factor of 1.3 (or use fixed values)
    gap = len(arr) if arr else 0
    
    swapped = True
    
    while gap > 1 or swapped:
        # Update gap size
        gap = int(gap / 1.3)
        
        # Ensure we don't divide by zero and keep a minimum gap of 1
        if gap < 1:
            gap = 1
        
        swapped = False
        
        for i in range(len(arr) - gap):
            # Compare elements with the current gap distance
            if arr[i] > arr[i + gap]:
                # Swap them
                arr[i], arr[i + gap] = arr[i + gap], arr[i]
                swapped = True
    
    return arr


# Test case from the prompt
if __name__ == "__main__":

    print("Comb sort test passed!")
